captions.detailed: A stylized toy race car featuring a bright red body shell mounted on a black base chassis. It has four black wheels with grey hexagonal hubcaps, each connected to the chassis via short, dark grey rectangular wheel mounts. The body consists of a flat rear spoiler, a curved central cockpit dome, and a tapered front hood, all styled in a solid red color.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a toy race car with a black rectangular chassis base, a red aerodynamic body shell, and four black wheels with grey hubcaps mounted on small rectangular axle extensions.
captions.factory: The code constructs a toy car using primitive shapes. It starts with a base chassis modeled as a black Box. The red body shell is built by combining a rear spoiler Box, a central curved dome (derived from a Cylinder oriented horizontally), and a front hood Box. Four wheel mounts are added as small dark grey boxes extending from the sides of the chassis. Finally, four wheels are created as black Cylinders with smaller grey Cylinders acting as hubcaps, positioned at each corner of the chassis.
